positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
90 BPM with a slow half-time feel
C minor, the hometown lullaby turned dark
muted low pulse-wave lead singing long sighing notes
cold glassy celesta and glass-harmonica figures
one distant low bell toll at the start of each phrase
a scorched orchard under a fallen star at night, melancholy, hushed and beautiful
seamless transition back to the theme
